# Policy-KB bijection audit — insurance_claims_and_denials / task 0

## revision_1

Scope: extended policies claim_ext_surgery_post_payment_refund, claim_ext_surgery_small_item_closeout, claim_ext_noncovered_convenience_closeout, claim_ext_member_decision_closeout (closure of task 0), the base policies they cite or whose clauses they retire (claim_denial_write_off, claim_recoupment_and_overpayment, claim_appeal_windows, claim_authorized_representative, claim_timely_filing, claim_denial_routing, claim_remittance_posting), the 7 variants' parameters, and the task-tool contracts. Corpus: 76 `docs/claim` documents (sha 00edccce7f3d608f). Method: every rule sentence of the four policies was matched mechanically (verbatim, else located and read) and every paraphrase read against the param values; every factor ladder tier compared; KB read sentence by sentence in the reverse direction.

## source_to_kb

**Hubs / write rules (scope, record, tool):**
- surgery refund → `outpatient_surgery_post_payment_denial_refunds`: scope (PPO/HMO/Marketplace, Outpatient Surgery Account, denied, ≥1 appeal), WO-72 recovery, earliest-payment/alphabetical-trace tie, replaced_by of the retired takeback clause verbatim, tool contract = task_tools docstring/body (oldest_payment sorted by posting_date then trace; payer_balance += amount). Equivalent.
- surgery small items → `outpatient_surgery_small_item_write_offs` (scope, BELOW_APPEAL_THRESHOLD, replaced_by verbatim, contractual-remainder sentence, tool). Equivalent.
- convenience → `take_home_convenience_item_write_offs` (scope, NONCOVERED_NO_WAIVER, replaced_by verbatim, tool). Equivalent.
- member decision → `member_decision_denial_close_out` (eligibility incl. "no member-level appeal (MEMBER_APPEAL_WITH_AOR)" rendered "a member appeal filed under the patient's authorized-representative form", member window with presumption days and >0 condition, decision booked by the patient, replaced_by verbatim, user-owned tool). Equivalent.

**Baselines (computation documents):**
- `outpatient_surgery_refund_amount_computation`: payment received, pre-op test domain (0300/0730/0324 and the code groups), retained value at expected allowed %, refund ≥ 0, round once, 0.00 → no entry. Complete; default constant named (contract modeling schedule).
- `outpatient_surgery_small_item_value`: list, test (> 0.00 and ≤ small-denial amount), value at %, recovery limit, rounding, prerequisite sentence. Complete.
- `take_home_convenience_value`: items, waiver test (liability source NONCOVERED_SERVICE rendered "non-covered service"), value = charges, no uninsured discount on the Outpatient Surgery class (agrees with encounter `uninsured_discount_schedule` row "Outpatient Surgery Account … no"), rounding. Complete.
- `member_decision_value_computation`: coverage, reading groups, value at %, assembly order, recovery limit less below-threshold write-offs, two prerequisite sentences, rounding. Complete.

**Factors (whole ladders, every tier):** surgery refund — lab schedule method (PPO@Grand Chute ×1.25 / HMO@hospital campus lesser-of / otherwise %, CLFS 7.77/8.46/4.29) in `preoperative_laboratory_schedule_pricing`; typing (PPO billing 29882 under 0360 → 0.00 / HMO units×11.50 / otherwise %) in `blood_bank_typing_value_on_surgery_refunds`; venipuncture 3.50/4.25/% ; ECG 28.00/34.00/% ; UA 4.10/3.60/% ; CXR 46.00/52.00/% — each with counted-unit convention and charge cap. Small items — J2405 1.90/1.65, J1100 0.85/0.95, J0690 6.40/7.10, splint (PPO@Grand Chute lesser-of 18.40 / HMO@hospital units×18.40 / %), J7050 2.10/2.60. Convenience — cold-therapy (Grand Chute 185.00/unit lesser-of; hospital 0.6×charges + 12.00/line lesser-of; else charges), cold pack 0.55/0.7/1, garment 0.6/0.75/1, kit 0.8/0.9/1. Member decision — OR method (PPO+29882 case rate 6150 + other OR × % × 0.5 packaging 0250/0272, capped; HMO 5480/1720 fee schedule; else %), implants (PPO@Grand Chute 520/410; HMO@hospital lesser-of per code; other codes %; else %), anesthesia 640/720/%, recovery 310/285/%, crutches (PPO@Grand Chute 31.50 / HMO@hospital 36.00 / %), site factor 0.92/1.04/1. Every tier, threshold and figure present; each factor in its own document; each names the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) records (codes, revenue codes, units, campus) it reads.

No other base clause is retired in the KB.

All variant figures (EAP, small-denial, appeal windows/levels, external review, AOR, filing, retro-auth, recoupment, follow-up, COB) match the tables one for one.

## kb_to_source

- Every normative prose claim traced to a rule sentence, ladder, variant figure, base compute or tool contract. Derivations (boundary tables, condition tables, the "only when the arthroscopy case rate … is paid" packaging reading = compute `0 if case rate paid`) are provable from the source.
- Additions: none. Cross-problem operational guidance ("first call …"): none — each tool name appears only in its own hub. Opening world state written as policy fact: none.
- Assembly sentences: the computation documents carry the rule's generic assembly order in softened words ("Each group of lines is valued first, never above the billed charges … a multiplier of the total applies after them, then the recovery limit …"); source: "Each adjustment below either replaces … or multiplies the total; replacements are made first …, the multiplier after them, then the recovery limit". Meaning unchanged; see `_difficulty.md` note N-1.

## bijection_verdict

**KB-BIJECTION: PASS** (task 0). No omission, softening, addition or mis-retirement found across the full domain of the four policies and the base clauses they touch.

## dependency_form

- Prerequisite sentences: verbatim, state form, blocked side only (table above). No restatement as an action, no tool/route/chain.
- Titles: general subjects; the root hub title names the on_request request type ("Closing a Denial on the Patient's Decision Not to Pursue a Member-Level Appeal").
- Computation documents: the assembly-order sentence presupposes a multiplier / scheduled amounts (N-1, source-originated, not counted as a KB finding).
- `blood_bank_typing_value_on_surgery_refunds` names "the arthroscopy case rate" (a member-decision factor concept) — carried from the source ladder; recorded as src-3.
- **KB-EXPLICIT RED — task-mirroring worked examples (task 0 world):**
  - **kb-1** `preoperative_laboratory_schedule_pricing_0cabe7c9`, "Worked example (hypothetical inputs)": "A Commercial PPO Claim for services at Grand Chute bills 2 units of 85025, 1 unit of 80048 and 1 unit of 85610 … together 35.3625" — exactly task 0's evidence rows (lines 85025 2u, 80048 1u, 85610 1u, PPO, Grand Chute) and task 0's lab-group value 35.3625 (GT factor_trace "fee schedule"), i.e. the factor document pre-derives this customer's tier and value.
  - **kb-2** `surgery_ondansetron_unit_rate_9be73fc1`, "Hypothetical footnote: 4 units on a Commercial PPO Claim with charges of 36.00 are valued at 7.60" — exactly task 0's J2405 line (4 units, 36.00, PPO) and its value.
  No scored value appears in any example or schema (unlock schemas checked).

**KB-EXPLICIT: RED** (kb-1, kb-2).
